1. Input at least a minimum amount of effort\knowledge of the Code of Conduct
- If you are in the Chain of Command or in Security, you are expected to put in the effort and do your job as a departmental leader/security personnel. This means you shouldn't: - Idle inside of your quarters for a majority of the round. - Barge into a department you are not the head of and begin making orders. - Commit violations of the Code of Conduct which would ultimately tamper the well-being of the server. - For Example: - As a security officer, you shouldn't go around killing people and not following arresting proceedure. But you could engage in something like Possession of Restricted Items. Instead you should: - Perform patrols of the station seeking out people who need assistance as the Captain. - Announce you have job openings available when your department is under-staffed. - Contextualize a violation and make a fair judgement on a sentence as a Warden or Head of Security.
- A member of Security or Command is expected to know the Code of Conduct more intimately than the average crew member, and to act more by it than other crew members.
